verdict.rationale: Paged KV-cache memory management is a fair axis for a local inference runtime like LocalAI, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions paged attention, KV-cache management, or memory-fragmentation handling. The items on GPU detection, distributed nodes and CPU paths are about other capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on paged memory management for attention key/value cache to maximize concurrent request capacity without memory fragmentation
